name: seis-design-token-audit
description: Read-only validation of SEIS design token categories, naming, states, and platform mappings.

interface.shortDescription: Audit token structure without changing design files.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic local SEIS design-system plugin that validates JSON token objects for required categories, primitive values, semantic states, and platform mapping hints without editing source files.
defaultPrompt: Check token states and platform mappings.
